newsitem.title: FRANCE: BA TAT to discuss second cargo feeder route.
newsitem.headline: BA TAT to discuss second cargo feeder route.

text.p: TAT European Airlines officials said they planned to meet with British Airways World Cargo counterparts early next month to discuss setting up a second feeder route for cargo traffic.
Since April 1996, TAT's Fokker 28 passenger service between Nantes and Toulouse has carried small-scale shipments for BA.
At Toulouse, shipments are transferred onto BA's scheduled Boeing 737 passenger services to London-Gatwick from where they are fed into the UK carrier's global cargo network.
"We are looking to extend the feeder concept to include our Nancy-Metz-Lorraine airport to Marseille F28 passenger service which operates several daily flights," a TAT cargo official told Reuters.
TAT staff at Nancy-Metz will be discussing the project with BA World Cargo at the beginning of September, the official added.
BA operates a daily Boeing 737 passenger service between Marseille and London Gatwick.

Earlier today, the European Commission said it cleared the plan announced by BA in July that it was exercising an option buy the remaining 50.1 percent of TAT it did not already own. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44-171-542-7706 Fax +44-171-542-5017
